table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	customicode=item.customicode,
	itemname = case printable when  0  then ltrim(str(item.icode)) + ' Counter Sale' else item.name end,
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc,
	reprintdate=getdate(), 
	users.username,  
	aliasname = accounts.aliasname, 
	accounts.name, 
	Address1 = customer.address1,
	Address2 = customer.address2,
	Phone = customer.phone,
	headerno =max(saleledger.headerno),
	posted=max(saleledger.posted),
	balance=isnull(max(balance),0),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.date,
	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,
	dbo.saleledger.custrefno,	
	dbo.saledetail.icode,   
	dbo.saledetail.gcode,
	salecatcode=max(saleledger.salecatcode),
	Id        = MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),     
	looseqty  = sum(saledetail.looseqty), 
	packqty   = sum(saledetail.packqty), 
	packunits = max(saledetail.packunits), 
	saleprice = max(saledetail.saleprice), 
	rate      = max(saledetail.rate),
	salestax  = max(saledetail.salestax),   
	discperc  = max(saledetail.discperc), 
	customername='                                  '  ,
	itemflatdisc  = max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),
	unitsalestax  = max(saledetail.unitsalestax),
	gstperc       = max(saledetail.gstperc),
	invgstperc    = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),
	reprintcounter=max(saleledger.reprintingcounter),
	serverdate=getdate()
	
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	dbo.saledetail,  
	item, 
	customer, 
	accounts,
	users 
	
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.customer.custcode ) AND 
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND 
	( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND
	( saledetail.icode = item.icode )  
	
GROUP BY 
	saleledger.saleinvcode, 
	saleledger.date, 
	/*saleledger.headerno,*/
	saleledger.custcode, 
	saleledger.discperc, 
	saleledger.flatdisc, 
	saleledger.misccharges, 
	saleledger.salestax, 
	saleledger.remarks,
	saleledger.custrefno, 
	saledetail.icode,
	saledetail.rowgroup, 
	saledetail.gcode, 
	item.name,
	item.customicode,
	item.packingdesc,
	item.icode,
	item.printable, 
	accounts.name,
	accounts.aliasname,
	customer.address1,
	customer.address2,
	customer.phone,
	dbo.users.username
ORDER BY 
	MAX(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: c_discounts
objects.visible: 1	if( Sum ( (  looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) ) *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum ( (  looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) ) *  (1 - saledetail_discperc  * .01)  ) * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) ) = 0, 0, if(page()=pagecount(),1,0))
objects.expression: Sum ( (  looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) ) *  saledetail_discperc  * .01  ) + sum(looseqty * itemflatdisc for all) + saleledger_flatdisc + (Sum ( (  looseqty *  (saledetail_saleprice - itemflatdisc ) ) *  (1 - saledetail_discperc  * .01)  ) * (  saleledger_discperc * .01) )

objects.name: c_nettotal
